description_en: Obtain the Security Token Service (STS) information of the service account and the temporary submission URL for the template file
description_zh: 获取服务账号STS信息和模板文件临时提交地址
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc get-sts-info-and-oss-path --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-id cp-bp11234abctmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStsInfoAndOssPath

parameters.help_en:
Ensures request idempotence.

You can generate a parameter value from your client to guarantee that this value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and must not exceed 64 characters
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without retrieving information. The system checks whether required parameters are provided, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request and retrieves information if all checks pass
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会获取信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接获取信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cloud connector instance. Valid value: cn-hangzhou only
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud connector
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
Template file name.

The template file supports only the CSV format
parameters.help_zh:
模板文件名称。

模板文件仅支持CSV格式
parameters.name: file_name

Expiration.description_en: UNIX timestamp indicating when the STS credentials expire

OssPath.description_en:
Temporary submission URL for the template file.

The format is `<BucketName>/<uid>/<FileName>`.

Based on the uploaded file name and user information, the system returns temporary STS credentials and the submission URL for the IP binding relationship CSV file. You must invoke the [PutObject]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31978.html） API to upload the file to this URL
OssPath.description_zh:
模板文件提交临时地址。

格式为`<BucketName>/<uid>/<FileName>`。

根据上传的文件名及用户信息，系统会返回临时STS信息和IP绑定关系CSV文件提交地址，该地址需要调用[PutObject]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31978.html）接口上传文件
